title: Immunofluorescent Image Acquisition and Quantification
author: Sabina Marciano
materials: Import the raw 10x images into QuPath .
Import images and corresponding ROIs into CellProfiler .
name of built-in-house pipelines: Transd.eff.cpproj, TH_IBA1_PSYN_SN.cpproj, TH_IBA1_PSYN_STR.cpproj
Pixel Density/Intensity: Quantify marker intensity per area (mm2).

steps.title: Set up microscope and acquire images
steps.instruction: Configure the Olympus BX61TRF microscope with the 10x objective, then acquire fluorescent images of nigral and striatal sections using the Hamamatsu ORCA‑Flash 4.0 camera, keeping exposure time and gain identical for all experimental groups.

substeps.instruction: Configure Olympus BX61TRF microscope with 10x objective
Acquire fluorescent images of nigral and striatal sections using Hamamatsu ORCA‑Flash 4.0 camera
Maintain identical exposure time and gain across all groups

steps.title: Manually delineate regions of interest
steps.instruction: Manually outline the Regions of Interest (ROIs) for the Substantia Nigra (SN) and the striatum on each acquired image.

steps.title: Export ROIs to ImageJ
steps.instruction: Export the defined ROIs from the imaging software into ImageJ to ensure compatibility with downstream analysis.

steps.title: Run blinded analysis pipeline
steps.instruction: With investigators blinded to genotype/treatment, run the in‑house ImageJ pipeline to identify objects, quantify total cell counts (e.g., TH+ or Iba1+ cells), and calculate per‑section cell counts or intensity values.

substeps.instruction: Quantify total cell count (TH+ or Iba1+)
Calculate cell count or intensity per section

steps.title: Normalize counts to ROI area
steps.instruction: Normalize each section’s cell count or intensity to its ROI area, expressing results as counts /mm².

steps.title: Average values per sample
steps.instruction: Average the normalized values from all sections belonging to the same sample to obtain a single representative value per subject.
